statement: Pinned Cemu Wii provider identifies normal extensions by six-byte A400FA and requests 16-byte A40020 when a Nunchuk/Classic is selected; it separately reads A600FA and activates MotionPlus by A600F0=55 and A600FE=04. The inspected command/response path has no Dolphin-style A400F6/4 or active A40040/16 gate. Because mapped MP can take over the A40020 bank, successful A40020 transport replies alone do not establish that Cemu interpreted downstream calibration correctly.

applicability.revision: Pinned consumer implementations in docs/wii-motionplus-consumer-comparison.md; no physical Wii Remote revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Cemu 29f2f1f WiimoteControllerProvider.cpp 324-432,925-950; WiimoteMessages.h 25-60; W8 merged results are a separate host record and are not experiments in this claim.
